en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a rural wooden church complex in an open field: a separate wooden belfry with a distinctive multi‑tiered, curved roof stands on the left, and a simple wooden church building with a steep roof and small tower or ridge ornament is on the right, both surrounded by a low fence and leafless trees. At the top of the image is a printed caption reading "Kyrkan Jukkasjärvi."
